name: Folder Size Check (Cronsole)
description: Recursively measure a folder’s total size and fail the run when it grows past your limit, so a folder that is supposed to stay bounded — a queue, a cache, a drop folder — gets noticed before the disk does.

parameters.label: Folder to measure
parameters.help: Absolute path as seen by the machine running the Cronsole backend — the container on a Dockerized stack, not your desktop.

parameters.label: Fail above (bytes)
parameters.help: Default is 10 GB, in bytes — 1 GB is 1073741824.
